latestVersion.changelog:
- Initial release of ccapi-api (v1.0.0) providing unified access to 60+ AI models (text, image, video, audio) through an OpenAI-compatible API gateway.
- Supports major models including GPT-5.2, Claude, Gemini, DeepSeek, Sora 2, Kling 3.0, Seedance 2.0, Suno, and more, via a single endpoint.
- Seamless integration with OpenAI Python/Node.js SDKs by simply changing the base_url.
- Offers standardized endpoints for text, image, video, audio/music generation, model discovery, and streaming.
- Transparent USD billing system with tiered pricing and pay-per-use.
- Comprehensive error handling and robust documentation provided.
